$comment: Versioned ApprovedOrder contract for C++ RiskEngine -> ExecutionEngine boundary. Any schema change increments $version below.
title: ApprovedOrder
description: Schema v1: A single, versioned definition of what a risk-approved order looks like as it leaves the RiskEngine.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must equal 1 in this phase. Consumers reject any other value.

cycle_id.description: UUID shared with the originating Signal (enables traceability/parity testing).

venue_symbol.description: Venue-specific symbol (Kraken pair or IBKR contract identifier).

direction.description: Order direction. 'hold' orders are never emitted.

quantity.description: Order quantity in units of the instrument. Strictly positive.

notional_usd.description: Notional value in USD. Strictly positive.

kelly_fraction.description: Half-Kelly fraction used for sizing. Bounded to [0, 0.5].

var_contribution_pct.description: Marginal VaR contribution as a fraction of NAV. Bounded to [0, 1].

risk_checks.description: Outcome of all risk checks. All must be true for the order to exist.

position_pct_ok.description: True if target notional respects AGENT_MAX_POSITION_PCT.

sector_pct_ok.description: True if sector concentration respects RISK_MAX_SECTOR_PCT.

var_ok.description: True if marginal VaR contribution respects RISK_MAX_VAR_PCT.

then.description: IBKR orders must always be paper in this phase. Hard-coded into schema, not left to downstream checks.
